Why MAHE

Established in 1953, we are the topmost private university in India recognized for our excellence in higher education. We began with the first self-financing medical college and has since expanded into a comprehensive university offering over 300 programs across various fields, including Allied Health Sciences, Applied Sciences, Architecture, Architecture, Art, Design & Technology, Basic & Applied Sciences, Biotherapeutics, Computer Applications, Data Science, Dentistry, Engineering, Health Sciences, Health Sciences/ Science, Technology & Management/ Humanities, Liberal Arts & Social Sciences, Hotel Management & Culinary Science, Hotel Management/Culinary Science/Dietetics & Nutrition, Humanities, Integrative Medicine, Law, Liberal Arts & Social Sciences, Life Sciences, Management & Commerce, Media & Communication, Medicine, Nursing, Pharmacy, Public Health, Regenerative Medicine, Virology.
